questions.explain: The chapter defines state signals (what is true now), trend signals (rate of change enabling predictive action), and causal signals (why something is happening, enabling targeted remediation).
options: Logs, dashboards, and alerts
State signals (what is true now), trend signals (rate of change), and causal signals (why it is happening)
CPU, memory, and disk counters
Thresholds, baselines, and forecasts
questions.q: What are the three signal classes the autonomous observability layer requires, and why?

questions.explain: Query Store normalizes SQL text via query_hash and query_plan_hash, producing stable identifiers that survive parameter changes so the decision engine can correlate current symptoms with historical remediation outcomes.
options: It compresses query text to save space
It tracks only ad-hoc queries
It provides licensing metrics
Query Store's query_hash and query_plan_hash give stable fingerprints that survive parameter changes, linking symptoms to past remediations
questions.q: What role does query fingerprinting play in autonomous root-cause analysis?

questions.explain: The Prometheus rules in the chapter set action_target: decision_engine labels, so Alertmanager fires webhooks directly to the decision engine's action API instead of notifying human on-call engineers.
options: Alertmanager fires webhooks directly to the decision engine's action API (action_target: decision_engine)
Alerts are suppressed entirely
Alerts go only to a Slack channel
Alerts trigger a manual runbook
questions.q: In the chapter's autonomous architecture, what is the different purpose of Prometheus Alertmanager compared to human-operated systems?

questions.explain: A signal crossing a static threshold but not anomalous in its context window is downgraded to informational; one with z-score above 3.0 but no threshold breach is elevated to warning — the engine acts on deviation from expected behavior.
options: Static thresholds are always superior
An anomaly that has not crossed a static threshold is still elevated to warning based on its z-score within its context window
Context windows only apply on weekends
ML-based detection is rejected
questions.q: How does contextual anomaly detection change severity classification relative to static thresholds?

questions.explain: Every autonomous action must be written to autonomous.action_log before execution with trigger signals, pre/post state, confidence, and rollback SQL — the post_state is filled by a deferred job ~60 seconds later for effectiveness feedback.
options: Action logs are optional for read-only actions
Every action is written to autonomous.action_log before execution with pre/post state, trigger signals, confidence, and rollback SQL
Logs are written only on failure
The audit log is just for auditors, not the decision engine
questions.q: What must the autonomous action audit log contain, and how is it used beyond forensics?
